designationHistory.name: Dungeness Spit Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Dungeness National Wildlife Refuge was established by Executive Order on January 20, 1915 for the land to be “ . . . as a refuge, preserve and breeding ground for native birds. ” The original 226.02 acres were known as the Dungeness Spit Reservation.
